title: scale-up --disk: honest deb13 root-not-last warning (no false success)
description: The disk path of scale-up (GAP #13, batch 3). scale-up --disk grows the backing .vmdk offline via `vmware-vdiskmanager -x`, restarts, then runs a SAFE in-guest filesystem extend: `growpart --dry-run` gates the extend and the code NEVER repartitions a live boot disk. The stock deb13 template lays swap AFTER root, so root is not the last partition -> growpart's dry-run correctly reports no adjacent free space -> the guest FS is left untouched and the result says so PLAINLY (Outcome ok, with a clear warning). This is the anti-false-success path: the disk space is present at the vmdk level but the verb does not pretend the filesystem grew. Live-verified 2026-07-05 on redis-1 (40 -> 42 GB vmdk grow; guest lsblk confirms the larger disk; growpart --dry-run detected root-not-last -> honest 'not auto-extended' warning). FOLLOW-UP already shipped: the deb13 packer preseed now drops the swap partition (2 GB /swapfile instead) so root is the single growable partition and future clones auto-extend.

prerequisites.smokeGate: nexus-infra-oltp smoke-0.G.1 ALL GREEN; redis-1 is a live replica (or pass --force-primary); build host = Windows with vmware-vdiskmanager on PATH

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.81 "lsblk -bdno SIZE $(findmnt -no SOURCE / | sed -E 's|/dev/||; s|[0-9]+$||') 2>/dev/null | head -1; echo '---'; findmnt -no SIZE /"

observe.what: the pre-grow disk size (~40 GiB) and the root filesystem size -- baseline before the resize

JSON: outcome=ok, oldDiskGb ~40 -> newDiskGb 42, AND outcomeReason = 'vmdk grown to 42 GB, but the in-guest root filesystem was NOT auto-extended: root partition ... a swap/extended partition likely follows it (root is not the last partition ...)'. The verb does NOT falsely claim the FS grew.

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.81 "lsblk | grep -E 'disk|part'; echo '---'; findmnt -no SIZE /"

observe.what: the DISK is now ~42 GiB (the vmdk grow took effect) but the root FS size is UNCHANGED -- matching the honest warning. The extra space is present at the block level; a growable-root template (root-last / swapfile) would let scale-up auto-extend it.

whatProves: scale-up --disk grows the vmdk safely and, when the guest layout cannot be extended in place (deb13 swap-after-root), leaves the filesystem alone and reports it honestly (Outcome ok + warning) rather than faking a resize -- the never-repartition-a-live-boot-disk safety contract.
